system.name: CMSwitch
system.one_liner: a compiler that optimizes resource allocation for computing-in-memory accelerators with dynamic compute/memory mode switching

components.name: CIM core
components.role: top-level hierarchical unit comprising a CIM array plus its peripheral buffer and control circuitry

components.name: buffer
components.role: buffers data for the CIM core

components.name: Ctrl.
components.role: control unit for the CIM core / CIM array

components.name: CIM array
components.role: array of CIM cells performing in-memory computation

components.name: Function unit
components.role: peripheral function unit supporting the CIM array's outputs

components.name: Driver
components.role: drives the CIM array's rows/columns for read, write, or compute

components.name: Memory circuits
components.role: memory-cell circuits forming the CIM array

components.name: Data IO / PSUM
components.role: data input/output and partial-sum output path of the CIM array

content.key_idea: CIM-based DNN accelerators are organized hierarchically from a CIM core down to a single CIM array of memory circuits with drivers and data-IO/PSUM paths, motivating why mode-switch overhead must be modeled at the array level.
content.reading_order: Left to right through three zoom-in panels labelled (a), (b), (c): from the whole CIM core, into a single CIM array with its control/buffer/function-unit periphery, into the memory-circuit and driver detail of one array.

style.stroke: thin black borders with dashed callout lines connecting the zoom-in panels
style.arrows: none (dashed zoom-in connector lines instead of arrows)

encoding.color_means: green = buffer bars, gray-blue = control/driver bars, light blue = array/memory cells, yellow dots = the selected row/column illustrating an access pattern
encoding.line_style_means: dashed lines connect each panel to the zoomed-in region of the previous panel
encoding.emphasis: successive zoom-in callouts from the whole CIM core down to a single CIM array make explicit the hierarchical structure that CMSwitch's hardware abstraction must model
reusable_patterns: nested zoom-in panels revealing hardware hierarchy from core to array to cell

evidence: independent CIM-based DNN accelerators are typically structured as hierarchical architecture comprising multiple CIM cores
Each core integrates a CIM array along with its peripheral buffer and circuitry

summary: This figure establishes the background hierarchical structure of CIM-based DNN accelerators that CMSwitch's compiler targets. It uses three zoom-in panels: (a) a CIM core containing a grid CIM array with top buffer and left Ctrl. bars, with one cell highlighted; (b) a single CIM array shown with its Ctrl., buffer, and Function unit periphery; and (c) the internal detail of a CIM array showing Driver, Memory circuits (a grid of memory cells), and a Data IO / PSUM output path. The progressively deeper callouts, connected by dashed lines, walk the reader from a whole accelerator core down to the individual memory-circuit array that performs the actual multiply-accumulate computation, setting up the paper's later discussion of mode-switching at the array/driver level.
summary_zh: 该图通过三层放大展示 CIM 加速器的层级结构：(a) 由多个 CIM 阵列及外围电路组成的 CIM 核心，(b) 单个 CIM 阵列及其控制/缓冲/功能单元，(c) 阵列内部的驱动器、存储电路与数据输出/PSUM 通路。
